validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
validation.emailTaken: Another user already uses this email.
validation.cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.
validation.cannotRemoveOwnAdmin: You can't remove your own admin role.
validation.lastActiveAdmin: There must always be at least one active admin.
validation.conflict: This record was changed by someone else while you were editing. Reload to see the latest version (your input stays on screen until you reload).
validation.invalidCode: Use capital letters, digits, spaces and . - / only, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.invalidComposition: Write the set with the digits 3, 2 and 1, e.g. 3+3+1+1.
validation.invalidOrderCode: Capital letters and digits, starting with a letter (e.g. ZOC).
validation.invalidIban: This IBAN is not valid (wrong length or check digits).
validation.activeAccountExists: There is already an active account for this currency. Deactivate it first.
validation.ratesExist: Rates for this date already exist. Edit that row in the table to correct them.
validation.modelCodeTaken: A model with this code already exists.
validation.presetExists: This model already has this set.
validation.fabricExists: A fabric with this brand and code already exists.
validation.modelInUse: This model is used by orders or customer codes, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
validation.imageTooLarge: The image can be at most 10 MB.
validation.notAnImage: Only JPG, PNG or WebP images can be uploaded.
validation.invalidPhone: This doesn't look like a phone number. Write it with the country code (e.g. +31 6 1234 5678) or as a national number of the selected country.
validation.invalidWebsite: Enter a web address like example.com.
validation.duplicateTaxId: This tax number type is already in the list.
validation.sameCurrency: The secondary currency must differ from the default currency.
validation.logoRequired: Upload the customer's logo, or choose a different label branding.
validation.customerHasOrders: This customer has orders, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
validation.invalidBarcodeFormat: An EAN-13 barcode has exactly 13 digits.
validation.invalidBarcodeCheckDigit: The last digit (check digit) doesn't match. Check the barcode for a typo.
validation.barcodeTaken: This customer already uses this barcode for another product.
validation.productCodeExists: This customer already has a code for this model, piece type and fabric.
validation.piecesRequired: Enter a set like 3+3+1+1 (a line needs at least one piece).
validation.percentTooLarge: A percentage can be at most 100.
validation.tooManyLines: An order can have at most 500 lines.
validation.noColumns: Add at least one column first.
validation.templateNameTaken: A template with this name already exists here.
validation.statusNotAllowed: This status change isn't allowed from the current status.
validation.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since the last issue — there is nothing new to issue.
validation.noBankAccount: There is no active bank account for this order's currency. An admin can add one under Settings → Bank accounts.
validation.issueCancelled: A cancelled order can't be issued.
validation.issueNoLines: Add at least one line before issuing.

users.title: Users
users.description: Create accounts, set roles and reset passwords.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with the user securely.
users.selfRoleHint: You can't change your own role.
users.resetDescription: Set a new password for {name}. They will be signed out of all devices.
users.deactivateDescription: They will be signed out immediately and won't be able to log in. Their history is kept.
users.reactivateDescription: They will be able to log in again with their current password.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change made in the system, newest first.
audit.noDetails: No field details are recorded for this action.

upload.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
upload.tooLarge: The image can be at most 10 MB.
upload.wrongType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.

company.title: Company settings
company.description: Company details, logo and order defaults printed on documents.
company.notSeeded: The company record hasn't been created yet. Run pnpm db:seed.
company.ordersDescription: Defaults used for order numbers and proformas.
company.orderCodeNote: Changing it affects new orders only; existing orders keep their code.

bankAccounts.title: Bank accounts
bankAccounts.description: Accounts printed on proformas; one active account per currency.
bankAccounts.oneActiveNote: Only one account per currency can be active. When switching accounts, deactivate the old one first.
bankAccounts.deactivateDescription: It will no longer be printed on new documents. Past documents are not affected.
bankAccounts.reactivateDescription: It becomes the account printed on new documents for this currency.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: Rates entered by hand each day. Price suggestions use the latest rate.
rates.derivedNote: The EUR/USD figure is derived from the two rates entered (EUR→TRY ÷ USD→TRY).
rates.missingUsingOlder: Price suggestions use the rates of {date}.
rates.missingNone: No rates have been entered, so no foreign-currency price can be suggested.
rates.askAdmin: Ask an admin to add them.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.description: Models, piece prices, packing data and sets.
catalog.createDescription: You can enter prices, packing data and sets on the next page.
catalog.codeHint: As written on documents, e.g. ZERDA.
catalog.modelDescription: Model details, piece prices and packing, sets.
catalog.activeHint: Inactive models are not offered on new orders; existing orders are not affected.
catalog.deleteDescription: It is deleted permanently with its piece prices and sets. Models used by orders can't be deleted; deactivate those instead.

pieces.title: Pieces
pieces.description: Catalog price and packing data per piece type. Rows left empty are not saved.
pieces.pricesReadOnly: Only admins can change prices. You can edit the packing data.
pieces.packageHint: Package count = labels printed per piece. 0 for accessories that travel inside another package (the extra cushion goes in its 3-seater's box).

presets.title: Sets
presets.description: Standard sets the model is sold in. The suggested price is what orders will suggest (at the latest rate).
presets.fixedPriceHint: Empty = sum of the piece prices.
presets.typeComposition: Type a valid composition to see a suggestion.
presets.missingRate: No exchange rate for this currency.

fabrics.deactivateDescription: It won't be offered on new orders. Existing orders are not affected.
fabrics.reactivateDescription: It can be chosen on new orders again.

fields.colorKeyHint: As the supplier writes it, e.g. A.GRİ.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Companies we sell to, with their document and label preferences.

pagination.label: Pages
pagination.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}} · page {page} of {pages}

customers.createDescription: Before saving we check for customers with the same email, phone or a similar name.
customers.phoneHint: Any format. Numbers without a country code are read in the selected country.
customers.secondaryCurrencyHint: Shown next to the main currency on documents, e.g. EUR next to USD.
customers.logoHint: Labels for this customer carry this logo instead of ours.
customers.activeHint: Inactive customers are hidden from the list and can't get new orders.
customers.fixErrors: Some fields need attention — see the messages above.

duplicates.title: This customer may already exist
duplicates.description: These customers have the same email, phone or a very similar name. Check them before creating a new one.

orders.emptyDescription: See this customer's orders in the order list, or start a new order with this customer's defaults.
orders.existing: {count, plural, one {# order is} other {# orders are}} already recorded for this customer.

customers.deactivateDescription: The customer is hidden from the list and can't get new orders. Their history is kept.
customers.reactivateDescription: The customer appears in the list again and can get new orders.
customers.deleteDescription: The customer and their product codes are removed for good. Only possible while they have no orders.

codes.description: The customer's own barcodes, stock codes and product names for our products, printed on their labels.
codes.barcodeHint: 13 digits, as printed under the barcode.
codes.barcodeCheckDigit: Wrong check digit: the last digit should be {digit}.
codes.deleteDescription: Labels printed from now on won't use it. Existing documents are not affected.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every order with its lines, totals and status.

new.title: New order
new.description: Choose the customer. Currency, delivery term and label settings are copied from the customer; delivery time and payment terms from the company settings.
new.numberPending: The order number is assigned when you first save.

columns.description: Extra columns for this order's lines. Choose on which documents each one is printed.

columns.saveAsTemplate: Save these columns as a template
columns.makeDefault: Default for this customer's new orders

issue.description: Freezes the order as it is now (company, bank accounts, customer, lines, totals) as the next proforma revision. The issued version never changes afterwards and can be downloaded in any language.

documents.previewHint: Draft from the current saved order — not issued, not stored.
